title: HB1481 (2021-2022 Regular): Authorizing certain school employees to carry firearms on school grounds.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2021-22/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1481.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Other changes are renumbering of subsections.

operative_text: Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.280): (4) Subsection (1)(a) of this section does not apply to any school personnel who has a valid concealed pistol license issued under RCW  9.41.070. For the purposes of this section, "school personnel" means any person employed by a school district, excluding classroom teachers as defined in RCW  28A.150.203 and paraeducators as defined in RCW  28A.413.010.
